# Protected paths: docs/design/agent-pipeline.md section 7.
# A pull request that touches one of these fails the `protected-paths` check, unless the
# owner added the label `protected-change-approved`. Read by host_tools/protected_paths.py.
#
# Rules: one pattern per line. A trailing / means the whole folder. Without a /, a pattern is
# an exact path from the repo root. `*` stays inside one folder; `**/` is any number of folders.
